author: Eric Skovan
text:
It has worked fine for me. I have never once had a new iOS version make the app not work.

If you’re talking about that warning that comes up after an iOS update saying ‘WARNING THE SOFTWARE HAS NOT BEEN FULLY TESTED WITH THIS VERSION…’ just ignore that, it’s just a legality, it doesn’t mean anything.
